item.title: OfiLibre coffee shops are back!
item.description: Next Wednesday, September 11th Cafes con OfiLibre are back! We’ll start the academic year talking about our upcoming plans, how you can stay informed about what we’re doing, and which initiatives the University is preparing regarding open access, free culture, and all the topics we care about at OfiLibre.

item.title: Presentation of Open Call for Subjects
item.description: The next Wednesday, September 4, we will have a video conference to present the 2024-2025 call for recognition of open access course publication.

item.title: URJC obtains aid for improvement of its infrastructure for open science
item.description: A few months ago, we applied for the María de Guzmán Grants for the promotion of excellent scientific research.

item.title: Summary of the III Free Culture Days 2024
item.description: III Free Culture Days have been a huge success. This event, which is gaining more followers every time, took place on March 20 and 21, 2024, at the Fuenlabrada Management Building of the URJC.

item.title: Free Culture Days 2024
item.description: In March 2024, we will have the third edition of the Free Culture Days of the URJC.

item.title: Happy 2024
item.description: Dear university community: From OfiLibre, part of the Vice-Rectorate for Community, Campus, Culture and Sports, we want to wish you a 2024 full of open materials, many open publications, using free software and reusing open data.

item.title: Open Access Publishing Opportunities for URJC PDI
item.description: ANECA has published a Draft of evaluation criteria for the 2023 Call for Research Sexenios, opening a public consultation process.

item.title: Open Subjects of the 2nd Quarter! (2023)
item.description: We’re back with new open subjects! Until last January, we were receiving requests for second-semester subjects.

item.title: Open subjects: a happy reality
item.description: The past June, the Call for Recognition of Open Access Course Materials 2022-2023 was published.

item.title: Open Access Courses (first quarter 2022-23)
item.description: Este es el listado de las asignaturas que han obtenido la baremación suficiente como para ser consideradas “Asignaturas en Acceso Abierto”, entre las que se han presentado a la Convocatoria para el reconocimiento de publicación de asignaturas en acceso abierto 2022-2023 (primer cuatrimestre).

item.title: Free Culture Days 2023
item.description: Free culture is closer than we think. It’s so close that in March 2023, we’ll have the Free Culture Days again at the URJC.
